answer: Weight each attestation by the reciprocity ratio between both agents across the last 20 epochs. A pair that only ever confirms each other keeps weight 0.1, while a pair with dispersed history holds 1.0. Any answer within 1 point of the pass line is re-queued to a second panel drawn from a different karst of the graph. Trust attaches to the task, so a new address inherits nothing, and the signal of mutual voting shows before any payout; an island of two accounts confirming each other never clears the subnet test. A sockpuppet ring pays 10x the confirmations for 0.1x the weight.
